parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The ID of the ELB instance.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerName
parameters.description:
The name of the ELB instance. The name must be **2** to **128** characters in length.

>  The value cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens modify-load-balancer-attribute --load-balancer-id lb-5q73cv04zeyh43lh74lp4gtm8 --load-balancer-name test --region cn-hangzhou
